newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products end firm on active buying, paper.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products end firm on active buying, paper.

text.p: NWE oil products ended firmer on Monday with buyers more active and paper giving physical prices a step up.
Heating oil barges were a touch firmer although futures' gains were shaved by easier premiums. Cargo premiums held or were a touch firmer on concern of Russian migration.
Gasoline moved higher on healthy buying interest with two persistent buyers seen bidding Eurograde barges up while one player sold it aggressively lower.

High sulphur fuel oil barges jumped $2 as one buyer pushed up prices to profit from a quotes-related cargo deal. High sulphur cargoes gained $1 on higher swaps. Low sulphur was well supplied and stable with little buying interest.
